b2.ryoka_witnesses_zel_ilvriss_war.news: Word out of the north: Wall Lord Ilvriss and General Zel Shivertail, called Tidebreaker, are fighting an open war, with the Trisstral Alliance caught between them.

canon_ref.note: Roughly four days along her road from the Gnoll camp, Ryoka finds a corpse-strewn battlefield, is spotted and taken prisoner by Ilvriss's soldiers, and is brought before him; his aide's detection stone confirms Teriarch's ring is Tier 5+ magic.

b2.ryoka_witnesses_zel_ilvriss_war.summary: Days out from the Gnoll camp, Ryoka stumbles onto a corpse-strewn battlefield between Wall Lord Ilvriss's and General Zel Shivertail's Drake armies, is captured and brought before Ilvriss, who confirms her ring is powerful magic but detains her anyway.

canon_ref.note: Ryoka breaks free using Octavia's stink potion, a pepper-spray potion and a homemade smoke bomb, fighting past soldiers with Muay Thai. She runs straight into Zel's cresting charge; he uses [Glorious Charge] to exploit the chaos she left behind.

b2.ryoka_escapes_ilvriss_and_turns_the_b.summary: Ryoka breaks free of Ilvriss's tent with a stink potion, pepper spray and a smoke bomb, fighting past soldiers to escape - straight into Zel Shivertail's surprise charge, unknowingly handing him the opening he needed to turn the battle.
